newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe dollar ends softer on tail-end pressure.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe dollar ends softer on tail-end pressure.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Tuesday easier on most hard units on the back of last-minute importer demand for foreign currency after an otherwise dull interbank trading session, dealers said.

"The market was very quiet for the greater part of the day but someone started buying at the last minute and that pushed our dollar down. He probably had a late payment to cater for," one dealer commented.

At Tuesday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against the U.S. unit at 10.3000/3200 compared with Monday's 10.2950/3150. Against the pound sterling it eased to 16.0210/0700 from 15.9920/16.0260.
It finished at 6.8030/8180 from 6.7850/7990 versus the mark but was quoted marginally firmer on the rand at 2.2800/2870 compared with 2.2810/2860 the previous day.
